result.instructions: Tools for Breeze ChMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Breeze ChMS data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run breeze_chms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run breeze_chms_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run breeze_chms_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. breeze_chms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: breeze_get_account_summary
tools.title: Get the account summary
tools.description: The church account this key belongs to: name, subdomain, status, timezone and country/currency. A cheap way to confirm BREEZE_SUBDOMAIN and BREEZE_API_KEY are right. Breeze: GET /api/account/summary.

tools.name: breeze_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people in the church database, optionally filtered (by tag, status, gender, etc.) and paginated with limit/offset. Without details you get id, first_name, last_name and photo path; with details=true every profile field is returned keyed by field_id (slower). Filter keys are profile field_ids (see breeze_list_profile_fields) or special keys, e.g. {"tag_contains":"y_16681"} for people in a tag, or {"2000138015":"226-227"} for a Status field matching options 226 or 227. Breeze: GET /api/people.

details.description: true = every profile field (slower); false/omitted = id and name only.

filter.description: Filter object, sent as Breeze's filter_json, e.g. {"tag_contains":"y_16681"}.

limit.description: Number of people to return. Omit to return everyone (can be large).

offset.description: People to skip, for pagination with limit.

tools.name: breeze_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Fetch one person's profile by id, including address and — by default — every profile field keyed by field_id, plus family members. Pair with breeze_list_profile_fields to label the field ids. Breeze: GET /api/people/{person_id}.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

details.description: Defaults to true (all information). false = only id and name.

tools.name: breeze_list_profile_fields
tools.title: List profile fields
tools.description: The church's profile layout: sections, each with its fields (field_id, field_type, name) and, for multiple-choice fields, their options (option_id, name). Needed to read person details, to build list_people filters, and to write fields with breeze_add_person / breeze_update_person. Breeze: GET /api/profile.

tools.name: breeze_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags (Breeze's groups/lists) with id, name, created_on and folder_id, optionally only those in one folder. To list the people in a tag, call breeze_list_people with filter {"tag_contains":"y_<tag_id>"}. Breeze: GET /api/tags/list_tags.

folder_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the tag folder.

tools.name: breeze_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List event instances in a date range (default: the current month), optionally on one calendar. Each row's `id` is the INSTANCE id used by attendance, volunteer and get_event tools; `event_id` is the series. Responses are cached by Breeze and may lag up to 15 minutes. Breeze: GET /api/events.

category_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the calendar (from breeze_list_calendars).

eligible.description: Include who is eligible to check in (everyone / tags / forms / none).

tools.name: breeze_get_event
tools.title: Get an event instance
tools.description: Fetch one event instance, optionally with the other instances in its series (then the response is an array of {id, start} only). Cached by Breeze, may lag up to 15 minutes. Breeze: GET /api/events/list_event.

instance_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the event instance.

schedule.description: Also return other instances in the same series.

schedule_direction.description: With schedule: instances before (default) or after this one.

schedule_limit.description: With schedule: how many series instances, 1-100 (default 10).

tools.name: breeze_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the church's event calendars (id, name, color and iCal feed address). The id is the category_id for breeze_list_events and breeze_add_event. Breeze: GET /api/events/calendars/list.

tools.name: breeze_list_attendance
tools.title: List attendance
tools.description: Who checked in to one event instance (person_id, check-in time created_on, check_out), optionally with each person's details, or the anonymous head count instead. Breeze: GET /api/events/attendance/list.

instance_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the event instance.

type.description: person (default) = named check-ins; anonymous = head count.

tools.name: breeze_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the church's online forms (id, name, url_slug, is_archived) — active ones by default, or archived ones. Breeze: GET /api/forms/list_forms.

archived.description: true = list archived forms instead of active ones.

tools.name: breeze_list_form_fields
tools.title: List form fields
tools.description: The fields of one form (field_id, field_type, name, options). Form entry responses are keyed by these field_ids. Breeze: GET /api/forms/list_form_fields.

form_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the form.

tools.name: breeze_list_form_entries
tools.title: List form entries
tools.description: Submissions to one form (id, created_on, person_id), and with details=true each entry's responses keyed by form field_id (see breeze_list_form_fields). Breeze: GET /api/forms/list_form_entries.

form_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the form.

tools.name: breeze_list_volunteers
tools.title: List volunteers
tools.description: Volunteers scheduled for one event instance: person_id, response, comment, rsvped_on and role_ids. Breeze: GET /api/volunteers/list.

instance_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the event instance.

tools.name: breeze_list_account_log
tools.title: List the account log
tools.description: The account's audit log for one action type (e.g. person_updated, tag_assign, contribution_added), optionally within a date range or by one user. Good for 'what changed since…' and incremental sync. Breeze: GET /api/account/list_log.

action.description: Which logged action to return (required by Breeze).

user_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the Breeze user who made the change.

details.description: Include a free-form description of each action (not standardized).

tools.name: breeze_list_funds
tools.title: List funds
tools.description: List giving funds (id, name, tax_deductible, is_default), optionally with the total given to each. Legacy endpoint: no longer shown on Breeze's current API reference; churches whose giving runs through Tithely may get an error. Breeze: GET /api/funds/list.

include_totals.description: Include the amount given to each fund.

tools.name: breeze_list_contributions
tools.title: List contributions
tools.description: List recorded contributions (gifts) given within a date range, optionally narrowed by giver (with their family), amount, payment method, fund, envelope, batch or form. Read-only: this server never adds, edits or deletes gifts. Legacy endpoint: no longer shown on Breeze's current API reference; churches whose giving runs through Tithely may get an error. Breeze: GET /api/giving/list.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the giver.

include_family.description: With person_id: include gifts from the giver's family members.

amount_min.description: Only gifts of at least this amount.

amount_max.description: Only gifts of at most this amount.

envelope_number.description: Only gifts with this envelope number.

tools.name: breeze_add_person
tools.title: Add a person
tools.description: WRITE: create a new person profile with a first and last name, and optionally set profile fields in the same call (same field shape as breeze_update_person). Check breeze_list_people first to avoid duplicates. Returns the new profile including its id. Breeze: GET /api/people/add.

fields.description: Profile fields to set (sent as fields_json).

field_type.description: Breeze field type: text, textarea, radio (multiple choice AND dropdown), checkbox, date, birthdate, email, phone, address or family_role.

response.description: The value. Text/date: the string (dates as M/D/YYYY). radio/checkbox: the option_id. email/phone/address: true, with the value in details.

details.description: Extra data for compound fields, e.g. email {"address":"a@b.org"}; phone {"phone_mobile":"111-111-1111"} (or phone_home / phone_work); address {"street_address","city","state","zip"}; family_role {"person_id":123,"role_id":3} (1 Unassigned, 2 Child, 3 Adult, 4 Head of Household, 5 Spouse).

tools.name: breeze_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: WRITE: set profile fields on an existing person — email, phone, address, dates, multiple-choice options, family role, and custom fields. Only the fields you pass change; the previous values are overwritten (read them first with breeze_get_person if you may need to restore them). field_id and option ids come from breeze_list_profile_fields. Breeze: GET /api/people/update.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

field_type.description: Breeze field type: text, textarea, radio (multiple choice AND dropdown), checkbox, date, birthdate, email, phone, address or family_role.

response.description: The value. Text/date: the string (dates as M/D/YYYY). radio/checkbox: the option_id. email/phone/address: true, with the value in details.

details.description: Extra data for compound fields, e.g. email {"address":"a@b.org"}; phone {"phone_mobile":"111-111-1111"} (or phone_home / phone_work); address {"street_address","city","state","zip"}; family_role {"person_id":123,"role_id":3} (1 Unassigned, 2 Child, 3 Adult, 4 Head of Household, 5 Spouse).

fields.description: Profile fields to set (sent as fields_json).

tools.name: breeze_add_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: WRITE: create a new tag, at the top level or inside a folder. Returns the new tag with its id. Breeze: GET /api/tags/add_tag.

folder_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the folder to place the tag in (default: top level).

tools.name: breeze_assign_tag
tools.title: Assign a tag to a person
tools.description: WRITE: add a tag to one person (e.g. put them in a small group or list). Undo with breeze_unassign_tag. Breeze: GET /api/tags/assign.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

tag_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the tag.

annotations.title: Assign a tag to a person

tools.name: breeze_unassign_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from a person
tools.description: WRITE: remove a tag from one person. The person and the tag both remain; re-assign with breeze_assign_tag. Breeze: GET /api/tags/unassign.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

tag_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the tag.

annotations.title: Remove a tag from a person

tools.name: breeze_add_event
tools.title: Add an event
tools.description: WRITE: create an event on the church calendar, optionally as another instance of an existing series. Times are Unix timestamps in seconds. This server cannot delete events, so a mistaken event must be removed in the Breeze app. Breeze: GET /api/events/add.

starts_on.description: Start time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

ends_on.description: End time, Unix timestamp in seconds (default: one hour after start).

all_day.description: All-day event; only the date of starts_on is used.

category_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the calendar to place the event on (default: main).

event_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the existing event series to add this instance to.

tools.name: breeze_record_attendance
tools.title: Check a person in or out
tools.description: WRITE: record attendance for one person at one event instance — check them in (default) or check them out (records when they left; checking out someone not checked in creates a record with matching in/out times). Breeze: GET /api/events/attendance/add.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

instance_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the event instance.

annotations.title: Check a person in or out

tools.name: breeze_schedule_volunteer
tools.title: Schedule a volunteer
tools.description: WRITE: schedule one person as a volunteer for one event instance. Breeze: GET /api/volunteers/add.

instance_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the event instance.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.
